## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to set the upper bound of a score anchor's range.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one (it is functional) and avoid an upper bound below the lower bound (SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:anchorRangeMax`](gmeow-anchorRangeMax.md) once per [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md), paired with a [`gmeow:anchorRangeMin`](gmeow-anchorRangeMin.md) it is not below.

### Examples

- ex:a1 [`gmeow:anchorRangeMax`](gmeow-anchorRangeMax.md) 1.0.
